note: LA.37a: a top-level Dart function's, getter's or setter's function_body is a SIBLING of its signature (function_signature / getter_signature / setter_signature) under the program root in tree-sitter-dart 0.1.0. HEAD: visit_top matches only function_signature, visit_function records the FUNCTION from the signature and never reads the body, so no top-level function has an outgoing call or client ENDPOINT, a top-level getter or `void set` setter has no node, and the FUNCTION's CODE / POSITION cells cover the signature only. An `external` function has no body; a comment may sit between signature and body; a top-level getter / setter pair is one FUNCTION owning both bodies.
